# Codecademy

> > An interactive learning platform offering tutorials and guides on programming, web development, AI/ML, cloud computing, and software engineering fundamentals.

Codecademy provides hands-on coding education covering languages like Python and JavaScript, frameworks like React and LangChain, development tools like VS Code and Docker, and emerging technologies including generative AI and agentic systems. The platform combines beginner-friendly guides with practical tutorials for building real-world applications.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- AI and Machine Learning
- LangChain and LangGraph
- React
- Generative AI and ChatGPT
- Prompt Engineering
- Docker and Kubernetes
- Visual Studio Code
- Git Version Control
- Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
- Test-Driven Development
- API Testing and Development
- User-Centered Design
- Cybersecurity

## AI and Machine Learning

- [How to Create Effective AI Prompts (With Examples)](https://www.codecademy.com/article/how-to-create-effective-ai-prompts): Guide to creating effective AI prompts with ChatGPT and generative AI
- [Top AI Agent Frameworks in 2025](https://www.codecademy.com/article/top-ai-agent-frameworks-in-2025): Comparison of LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI and other AI agent frameworks
- [How to Build Agentic AI with LangChain and LangGraph](https://www.codecademy.com/article/agentic-ai-with-langchain-langgraph): Tutorial on building autonomous AI agents with LangChain and LangGraph
- [CPU vs GPU: What's the Difference and Which One Should You Use?](https://www.codecademy.com/article/cpu-vs-gpu-whats-the-difference-and-which-one-should-you-use): Comparison of CPU and GPU architecture, performance, and use cases

## Development Tools and Environment Setup

- [Getting Started with Visual Studio Code](https://www.codecademy.com/article/visual-studio-code-setup): VS Code installation and setup guide for coding and debugging
- [Setting Up Postman](https://www.codecademy.com/article/setting-up-postman): Setup guide for Postman API testing and HTTP request development
- [Web Programming on a Chromebook](https://www.codecademy.com/article/web-programming-on-chromebook): Setup Chromebook for web development with Linux and VS Code
- [How to Force Git Pull to Overwrite Local Changes in Git](https://www.codecademy.com/article/force-git-pull): Git force pull guide using git reset and git stash commands

## Web Development and React

- [React: The Virtual DOM](https://www.codecademy.com/article/react-virtual-dom): Explains React's Virtual DOM and DOM manipulation optimization techniques
- [Browser Compatibility](https://www.codecademy.com/article/f1-u5-browser-compatibility): Cross-browser compatibility guide for CSS and HTML web development
- [Introduction to User Centered Design](https://www.codecademy.com/article/ui-design-intro-to-ucd): User-centered design process, research, and iteration fundamentals

## Python Programming

- [List Comprehensions](https://www.codecademy.com/article/list-comprehension): Python list comprehensions tutorial for creating lists in one line
- [How to Sort Lists of Lists in Python (With Examples)](https://www.codecademy.com/article/how-to-sort-lists-of-lists-in-python): Python nested list sorting using sorted(), lambda, and key functions

## Cloud Computing and DevOps

- [What is Cloud Computing Architecture?](https://www.codecademy.com/article/what-is-cloud-computing-architecture): Cloud architecture fundamentals with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud examples
- [What is Kubernetes](https://www.codecademy.com/article/what-is-kubernetes): Introduction to Kubernetes container orchestration and Docker integration

## Testing and Quality Assurance

- [Reading Tests with Mocha and Chai](https://www.codecademy.com/article/bapi-reading-tests): Tutorial on reading JavaScript tests written with Mocha and Chai frameworks
- [Testing Models in Swift](https://www.codecademy.com/article/testing-models-in-swift): Guide to unit testing Swift code with Xcode for robust applications

## Optional

- [Threat Hunting](https://www.codecademy.com/article/threat-hunting): Proactive cybersecurity defense using threat intelligence techniques
- [Get Started with Amundsen](https://www.codecademy.com/article/get-started-with-amundsen): Bootstrap Amundsen data catalog with Docker and Neo4j backend
- [All the (Internet of) Things](https://www.codecademy.com/article/all-the-internet-of-things): IoT insights by Limor Fried, founder of Adafruit Industries
